author: danandsueco
text:
Luska wrote: My Vessel delayed for 14 hrs...Managed to locked in 35 pips and counting... In this ping pong range just sell the high and buy the low until either one breaks and re-entry at retest...

Your statement here is near perfect. When a pair is rangebound buying the lower demand levels and selling the higher supply levels targeting the next nearest fresh zone will allow a trader to increase their risk/reward ratio as well as increasing their potential to hit targets. If the range breaks, waiting on that retest is a high probabilty winner. Key point in all, let the market come to you and if you're willing to wait... it always comes knocking. Keep locking those pips!
